name: Erik Mesic
headline: Student at NYU Stern — Finance | Certified Public Accounting Track — Pre-Law
summary: I study finance and the intersection of business, law, and governance. My work spans legislative advocacy, educational reform, debate, and quantitative research.
about: I am an undergraduate student at NYU Stern in the Certified Public Accounting track with minors in Mathematics and Computer Science. I focus on corporate governance, public policy, and education reform. I have organized student associations, led advocacy work, and completed quantitative projects integrating Python models and statistical inference.
